records.allowed_use: Use to describe a declared design axis and a preparation path.
records.claim: The proposal treats mathematical layout as a declared prospective axis supported by offline semantic identity and projection evidence.
records.limit: Do not present this as physical layout reconstruction, venue geometry, camera calibration, photometry, mapping accuracy, or fixture accuracy.

records.allowed_use: Use to support offline software feasibility in the proposal.
records.claim: The candidate provides an offline signal-to-proposal-to-projection-to-evidence path.
records.limit: The result is bounded to the recorded repository path and does not establish execution outside it.

records.allowed_use: Describe deterministic replay of the registered fixtures.
records.claim: The recorded signal envelope replays into a stable review result.
records.limit: The determinism claim applies to the registered fixtures and not to an unrecorded input.

records.allowed_use: Describe a proposal-only state with no automatic decision.
records.claim: The recorded proposal uses proposal_only execution mode and declares no automatic actions.
records.limit: This state is evidence of a bounded proposal and is not execution permission.

records.allowed_use: Describe the explicit human approval gate in the pending state.
records.claim: The pending projection requires explicit approval.
records.limit: No operator approval event is included in the recorded evidence.

records.claim: The proposal and shared projection declare reversible pending state.
records.limit: The matrix does not claim a host rollback event or recovery measurement.

records.allowed_use: Describe the offline no-effect safety boundary.
records.claim: The recorded path declares no external side effects and no automatic actions.
records.limit: The result is a software boundary check and not an observation of an external installation.

records.allowed_use: Use as shared contract evidence for future consumers without importing RESOLUME domain code.
records.claim: SurfaceProjectionV1 carries shared proposal, evidence, identity, approval, reversibility, and safety fields.
records.limit: Future consumers remain contract candidates and are not represented as completed host integrations.

records.allowed_use: State the required future validation gate and keep all live claims out of verified evidence.
records.claim: Live Resolume, audio, lighting, venue, hardware, camera, GPU, network, and transport validation remains pending operator-approved work.
records.limit: Do not describe any of these live behaviors as completed evidence before an authorized validation run.
